# 3 Axial Skyrmions
- The definition of the relative phase in this work differs by an addition of π from that in refs.[3, 12, 7] because the antiSkyrmion is formed by changing the sign of only a single pion field, allowing for a more natural comparison with monopoles.
- The Skyrmion and antiSkyrmion are joined continuously as the profile function becomes zero at a radius of s/2 from the center of each core, with the fields set to the vacuum state outside this region.
- Initial conditions were established using the simple ansatz (3.7) as well as more complex conditions based on the rational map ansatz [11] that featured an axially symmetric charge n map.
